missing.title: Access token required
missing.text: A token is needed to open the console. The command prints a link with the current token and opens it:

rejected.title: Token rejected
rejected.text: The service rejected the token you supplied (HTTP 401). It is most likely stale, or was copied incompletely — the current token is printed by the command itself.
rejected.lead: The command prints a ready link with the current token and opens it:
rejected.note: The token was rejected by the service

progress.approxTitle: time since the console saw this task — it started earlier

bankMenu.syncTitle: Reindexes only changed files and removes deleted ones from the index
bankMenu.rebuildTitle: Wipes the index and rebuilds it from scratch — slow, proportional to the bank''s size
bankMenu.mcpTitle: This bank''s token and a ready-made config fragment for a project
bankMenu.removeTitle: Unregister the bank; .md files are untouched

picker.title: Add bank
picker.pathLabel: Directory with .md — it becomes the bank''s root
picker.truncated: showing the first {n} directories — paste the rest as a path
picker.noMd: this directory has no .md — nothing to index
picker.countTruncatedTitle: the count timed out — there are at least this many files, all of them will be indexed
picker.excludesTitle: excludes .git, .venv, node_modules — same as what the indexer skips

hint.alreadyBank: this directory is already a memory bank
hint.hasNestedMemory: this directory already has a .claude/memory structure
hint.willConnect: Will be connected once the structure is created
hint.projectOnly: available only for a bank at «‹project›/.claude/memory»

token.title: MCP access
token.regenTitle: Issue the bank a new token; the old one stops working immediately
token.regenConfirm: Regenerate the token for bank «{name}»? The old one stops working immediately: every config that already holds it — ~/.claude.json, another project''s .mcp.env — will stop connecting until you put the new one in.
token.regeneratedNote: Token regenerated. Configs with the old token will no longer connect — put the new one in them.
token.hideTitle: Remove the value from the screen
token.copyTokenTitle: Copy the token without showing it
token.copyFailed: Couldn''t copy — select the text and copy it manually
token.scopeNote: Opens only the bank «{name}». The service token this console is open with is broader — it does not belong in a project config.

entryHint.base: This is how the entry shows up among other MCP servers; it also becomes the prefix of the tool names — mcp__{entry}__search.
entryHint.own: It is also where {var} comes from: the token belongs to one bank, so a second bank in the same project does not overwrite the first one’s token. MNEMO_HOST and MNEMO_PORT are shared — they name the service, not the bank.

token.scopeHint: The second — if the project has .mcp.json.template and mcp-setup.sh: values there are substituted from .mcp.env, and only the template rides in git. Otherwise the first: .mcp.json holds the values directly and is in .gitignore.

caption.literal: For the project''s .mcp.json or ~/.claude.json — merge into «mcpServers»

templateLead.part1: All three files are filled in by
templateLead.part2: — the fragment into .mcp.json.template, the variables into .mcp.env, the substitution lines into mcp-setup.sh. It does not create .mcp.env itself: that is a file with secrets, so first run
templateLead.part4: — that is what assembles .mcp.json with the actual values. Below is exactly what init will write: to preview it, or to fill it in by hand if init cannot be run in this project.

manualPaste.part1: If you fill it in by hand, add to the
manualPaste.part3: . Without it the placeholder lands in .mcp.json verbatim, and the script still reports success — so the failure only shows up when the server silently fails to connect.

token.generatedFileNote: .mcp.json is a generated file: it is in .gitignore, and mcp-setup.sh rewrites it from the template. The entry must live in .mcp.json.template, or the next run of the script will wipe it.

removal.title: Remove bank
removal.leadSuffix: will stop existing for this machine.
removal.goneForeverText: The bank''s registration and its token. The token is issued at random and cannot be recreated: every .mcp.json that connects with it stops working, and the same token can never be recovered.
removal.untouchedSuffix: . The console does not delete the bank’s contents — only what was derived from it.
removal.dropIndex: also delete the index ({bytes}) — recoverable with a full reindex
removal.confirmLabel: Type the bank name to confirm

pane.selectBankHint: Select a bank on the left
pane.chunkVizTitle: Show chunk boundaries as they lie in the index
pane.selectFileHint: Select a file in the tree

header.addBankTitle: Register a new directory with .md as a bank

banks.emptyHint: No banks registered yet — "＋ Add bank" in the header picks a directory with .md.

enabled.label: Active
enabled.note: Watching the files, the index updates itself, search works.

frozen.label: Frozen
frozen.note: Not watching the files — the index stays as-is, but search still works. This is what saves a full rebuild when the model changes.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.note: Not watching, not searching. The bank stays in the registry.

statusNote.indexingHasChunks: the base exists, fresh changes are catching up
statusNote.indexingEmpty: first build in progress — still empty

bank.frozenBadgeTitle: The index is not updating — files may have changed since {date}. Search still works and answers from that state.

tree.selectBankHint: Select a bank on the left

notice.actionable: {n} bank(s) have an index from a previous model
notice.suffix: . Search over stale vectors refuses rather than mixing two spaces.

dialog.lead: A full reindex will be queued for {n} bank(s). Old derived indexes will be wiped and rebuilt from the .md from scratch.
dialog.note: .md files are not changed. Time is proportional to size; the exact speed depends on this machine''s backend and hardware.

header.count: {n, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {c, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}
header.addTitle: Create or adopt a new agent

tree.empty: No agents yet — "＋ Add agent" creates the first one.
tree.noChats: No chats yet — select this agent to start one.

workspace.selectHint: Select an agent on the left, or create a new one.
workspace.stubTitle: Pick a chat, or start a new one
workspace.stubBody: Select an existing chat in the tree, or use "＋ New chat" to start one. Switching between chats never stops background generation — only deleting a chat does.

console.dropHint: Drop a file to attach it

wizard.title: Add agent
wizard.newFolderHint: Will be created automatically under the engine's own agents directory.

confirm.title: This folder already has something — confirm before adopting
confirm.note: What's already there is adopted as-is, nothing gets overwritten; whatever's missing is filled in.

wizard.backendStandardHint: Claude Code CLI/SDK defaults — the subscription or key as configured, nothing to fill in.
wizard.backendSavedHint: Saved in the agent's own launch.json — per-agent, not a machine setting.
wizard.linksHint: MCP / Skills / Rules aren't picked here — they attach later, separately, for this agent.
wizard.launchWarnNote: Agent «{name}» created, but the backend setting couldn't be saved: {error}

general.subagentsEmpty: No .claude/agents/*.md files in this agent's own folder.

backend.savedHint: Saved in this agent's own launch.json — per-agent, not a machine setting.

links.hint: Attached from the registry — each subsection shows only what's already attached to this agent. The name and template variable values can be changed only for this agent, not in the registry.

pick.title: Attach {category} from the registry
pick.ariaLabel: Attach a registry entry to this agent
pick.empty: Nothing available — everything is already attached, or the registry is empty.

list.empty: Empty — add an entry via "＋ Add".

error.duplicate: This MCP server already exists in the registry: {name}

header.title: Settings
header.sub: applies to this machine, not one bank

lede.general: What concerns the console and the machine as a whole — not one bank, and not the embedding backend.
lede.embed: Which backend computes vectors for search across banks, and how much RAM it takes for that.
lede.maint: The same structured doctor report the CLI prints as text. Checks run only when this section is opened.

settings.overrideNote: overridden by the {var} environment variable — what is saved here has no effect while it is set
settings.notSavedToggle: not saved — currently {state}; press "Save" to apply

theme.label: Console theme
theme.note: This browser''s own choice — applies immediately, does not wait for "Save".

language.label: Language
language.note: This browser''s own choice — applies immediately, does not wait for "Save".

autostart.label: Start the service at logon
autostart.note: Registers as {mechanism}{named}. Applies from the next logon; what is running now is untouched.
autostart.savedOn: Autostart: the service will come up at logon
autostart.savedOff: Autostart: off, you will need to start the service yourself

autoUpdate.label: Automatic update
autoUpdate.note: A fit release applies itself — with a short countdown and a "Cancel" button right in the console. Off — only the banner and manual confirmation remain, as before.

requireLogin.label: Require a token to sign in
requireLogin.noteOff: Off (default): "/api" (console and CLI) is open on loopback, as now — no token.
requireLogin.noteOn: On: the console and CLI need a service token to access.
requireLogin.savedOn: Signing in now requires a token
requireLogin.savedOff: The console is open on loopback again, no token
requireLogin.tokenNote: Shown once — GET /api/settings will not return it again. The console has already adopted this token for the current session, so signing in again is not needed. If it''s lost — the same file is on disk (the path and mnemo doctor will show it), or turn this option off again to drop the token requirement.

warn.line1: Changing the model or width is a new rebuild key.
warn.line2: The configuration takes effect after saving settings.
warn.line3: Old indexes get REBUILD PENDING and search over them refuses until they are regenerated.

embed.notSavedBackend: not saved — currently active is "{active}"; press "Save" to switch to "{target}"

ollama.label: Ollama
ollama.note: a local service; on a GPU, rebuilding a bank is noticeably faster — the exact gain depends on the card

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.note: the bank''s memory leaves the machine — a deliberate choice, not the default

intfloat/multilingual-e5-large.note: ships with mnemo; ~2.2 GB, runs on the CPU resident

bge-m3.note: recommended: no prefixes, 8K window, fast on a GPU

zylonai/multilingual-e5-large.note: the same model as the local resident

nomic-embed-text.note: also has prefixes, but its own — not e5''s

model.prefixedNote: this model is trained with markers — mnemo will add them itself

local.lead: The resident on this machine computes vectors —
local.tail: No byte of memory leaves the machine.

embed.dimNote: The width is filled from the catalogue, but the endpoint has the final word: mnemo checks it against the first vector received and refuses to write the index if they disagree.
embed.keyNote: Stored in settings.json on this machine. Never shown back — a page that prints a secret prints it into a screenshot too.

key.placeholderStored: stored — type a new one to replace it

mem.label: RAM
mem.introStrong: The model comes up on its own when needed for search or indexing
mem.introRest: — "not in memory" is a normal state, not an error. "Unload" frees the memory right away, instead of keeping the model loaded just in case.
mem.downloadBtn: Download the model to disk (2.2 GB)

note.wakeSoon: It will come back in a few seconds
note.naHosted: This endpoint holds nothing on this machine — the model lives on the provider''s side, so there is nothing to free.
note.naProbeCost: "Check endpoint" makes one embedding request. For a metered API this can be a paid call.
note.othersHeld: There are also {n} other model(s) there — not ours, we leave them alone

mem.unloadedNote: Memory freed. The model will come back on its own on the next search.
mem.loadedNote: The backend responded — the model is in memory
mem.busyError: The queue is still working through this backend — wait until it clears and try again.

errors.dimNotPositive: Dimensions must be a positive number
errors.refreshFailed: Settings saved, but not every state could be re-read. Refresh the page — no need to save again.

saved.restartRequired: Saved. Takes effect after the service restarts.
saved.appliedNoPending: Saved and applied. Check the backend with the button above.
saved.appliedPending: Saved and applied. Check the backend with the button above, then regenerate the banks with REBUILD PENDING on the main screen.

maint.notFetched: The report has not been received yet

token.notSet: not set · /api is open on loopback by default

orphans.noneNote: Every index belongs to a bank
orphans.sectionNote: Doctor only shows them. Cleanup happens only as a separate confirmed action — never automatically, never together with diagnostics.
orphans.confirmText: Only these shown derived index ids will be deleted: {ids}. The registry is re-checked before each deletion; .md files are untouched.

confirm.warning: The mnemo service will be stopped and restarted on the new version. Search and indexing are unavailable while this happens. Once you press "OK" the action cannot be cancelled — progress is shown until it finishes.
confirm.staleTarget: The version shown is stale (current: {tag}). Close this window and try again.

autoPending.note: If nothing is clicked, the update applies automatically. "Cancel" only postpones it — the same version may be offered again on the next check.

progress.title: Updating to {tag}…
progress.switchingNote: The service is restarting — the page will lose its connection for a few seconds. This is expected: the result becomes known as soon as the connection recovers.

timeout.text: Couldn''t learn the update''s outcome within the allotted time. The service may still be restarting, or the console can''t reach it right now. Check manually (mnemo doctor) or try again.

terminal.rolledBack: A problem occurred updating to {tag} — rolled back to {current}
terminal.unknownState: Service state may be undefined — check mnemo doctor
terminal.unchanged: The current version was not changed
